name: Tripping the Rift cuts Backtrack's cooldown when Clasp of Infinity is cast (#1945)
contract: Tripping the Rift 520173 is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 521214, a single SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN (165) with EffectMiscValue 706973 (Backtrack), EffectBasePoints -10001 (die 1 => -10000 ms) and implicit target 1 (caster). Effect 165 is implemented, but Spell.dbc gives 520173 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the proc never fired. Backtrack 706973 has RecoveryTime 40000; with a spell_proc row keyed on Clasp of Infinity 805847 (family 28, word0 0x800000), one Clasp cast must take a full 10 sec off it. The assertion window is 4 sec, so wall clock alone can never account for a 9 sec drop.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Backtrack is on its 40 second cooldown
Clasp of Infinity takes 10 seconds off Backtrack
